patthana17.13:1.1: akusalaṃ hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na hīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.13:2.1: abyākataṃ majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na abyākato na majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana17.13:3.1: kusalaṃ paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. kusalattika micchattattike nakusalattika namicchattattikaṃ
